assembled_full_reference_support.derivation: Full-support fields use the native small-region renewal plus exactly the unchanged removed auxiliary outside sources. The reference_support_renewals diagnostics intentionally refer to that same cropped small renewal, not the assembled full source count. These total counts and L1 are independently reconstructed from the disjoint cropped and removed diagnostics; maximum axial coefficient remains bounded by max(auxiliary,small).

reference_frequency_fit.fit_model: One shared fundamental fitted to reference Cl with constant, linear trend and harmonics 1..3; boundary fields fitted at that frequency with the same basis and native area weights. Complex amplitude = cos coefficient - i sin coefficient; positive coherent phase is phase lead. Only 2.25 lift cycles, so fitted trends and phases are descriptive, not long-run confidence bounds.

scope: Reference-driven independent cold particle images only. Every frame has zero auxiliary coefficient history, fixed ten nonphysical inverse iterations, one independent native small-region renewal and shared outside coefficient crop. Final image native budgets are enforced; earlier coefficient-search iterates may exceed the final closure bound and are never exported as solver steps. All three worker start images repeated bitwise. No particle arrays are retained in published fields, so state classifications and coefficient budgets are verified against hashed captured diagnostics plus native guard rules, not independently recomputed from particles. No autonomous VPM advection/diffusion equivalence or force recovery is demonstrated by this field audit.
limitations: Finite reference domain and freestream continuation omit wake beyond x=24; owned exit-straddling circulation is zero under the unchanged blend support.
Gaussian image core/spacing and bounded inverse/pruning are the current native choices; the field image is an oracle diagnostic, not the physical production coefficient trajectory.

The strong mixed boundary is evaluated through Un and Gt=P_t(J n), the normal derivative of tangential velocity. Force causality requires the paired fresh FVM controls using the same primary/BDF/face-flux initial state and .04-to-.008 endpoint interpolation.
Historical warm whole-horizon auxiliary projection remains inadmissible due coefficient growth; this cold report does not rehabilitate those prior force controls.
